title: Surprise Wins Shake Up the China Open
summary:
The China Open tennis tournament in Beijing has been full of surprises. World number two Aryna Sabalenka lost to Nikola Bartunkova, the BBC reports. Bartunkova is 20 years old, comes from the Czech Republic and is ranked 34th. She won 6-4, 6-3.

Just one day earlier, world number one Elena Rybakina also lost. She was beaten by Alina Charaeva of Armenia, who is ranked 118th.

It is the first time since 2015 that the top two players both left the China Open this early.

"She's a legend, so I'm really happy that I won the match," Bartunkova said.

Sabalenka won two big tournaments in March, but she has not won a title since then. During the match, she threw her racquet in frustration.

Other stars kept winning, including Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova and Naomi Osaka. Rybakina said she will skip the Wuhan Open to rest a hurt foot.
why_it_matters: It shows that in sports, rising young players can beat famous stars.
